subject: Front-end audit assignment: concepts, IA, Chat layout
body: New high-priority assignment: study the entire Vue front-end and produce a review, not a rewrite yet. Scope: App shell, kernel/plugin architecture, all panes, stores/api/theme, routing, Element Plus usage, ECharts timeline, build and tests. Questions to answer: (1) which concepts/labels/functions are unclear or duplicative; (2) what navigation/information architecture should be; (3) what should be components vs panes; (4) why Chat input/history overlap and how to implement pinned input plus independent history scroller without overlap; (5) what regression tests should pin it. Coordinate, do not edit web/src while I am working there; reply with findings and proposed patch. I am doing an independent audit and then fixing the Chat layout first.
